import matplotlib.pyplot as plt 
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('table_name.csv')

# Create a stacked bar chart
plt.bar(df['Vintage'], df['Preqin Median Net IRR'], label='Preqin Median Net IRR')
plt.bar(df['Vintage'], df['LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'], bottom=df['Preqin Median Net IRR'], label='LN PME Using S&P 500 TR')

# Set labels and title
plt.xlabel('Vintage Year')
plt.ylabel('Cumulative Performance (%)')
plt.title('Stacked Bar Chart of Investment Performance by Vintage Year')
plt.legend()

# Chart INFO: {'x_fields': 'Vintage', 'y_fields': ['Preqin Median Net IRR', 'LN PME Using S&P 500 TR'], 'chart_type': 'stackedBarChart'}
plt.show()
